dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D parabolic narrowing from the mid-body region towards the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical protrusion on the left lateral margin at mid-body; otherwise smooth, continuous curves.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform medium-grey tone; consistent across the visible dorsal plane excluding specular highlights.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey vertical streaks across the central and posterior dorsal region.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Series of faint, low-contrast vertical linear marks distributed across the mid-dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced linear shadow along the posterior midline indicating a structural dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple faint, parallel vertical linear marks on the mid-dorsal plane consistent with surface abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: Circular, high-contrast dark aperture positioned on the anterior-dorsal region corresponding to the blowhole.
